files.description: Top-level orchestrator agent. Extends AbstractAgent. Registers all toolkits (FileSystemToolkit, ShellToolkit, MemoryToolkit, CoquiSourceToolkit, auto-discovered toolkits) and all standalone tools (spawn_agent, credentials, package_info, php_execute, vision_analyze, restart_coqui, config, summarize_conversation, extract_memories, coqui_toolkits, coqui_skills). Shell is open by default (empty allowlist — all commands permitted); agents.defaults.shellAllowedCommands enables opt-in restrictive mode; agents.defaults.allowSudo (default false) controls sudo access; allowSudo/allowedCommands are passed to SpawnAgentTool for child agents. Memory is SQLite-backed via MemoryStore with FTS5 full-text search and optional vector embeddings; core memory summary is auto-injected into instructions(). Resolves a ContextWindow from ModelDefinition at construction time and passes it to AbstractAgent for per-iteration token budget enforcement. Budget gate respects explicit Eager/Deferred overrides from ToolkitLoadingRegistry, uses percentage-based promotion for Auto candidates. Also builds prompt-section telemetry with pinned-versus-deferrable classification and rationale for budget inspection surfaces. Supports a per-turn notification prompt section injected outside the cached base instructions so transient background-work notifications remain visible to the model without polluting persisted conversation history. Constructed fresh on every REPL turn.

files.description: Handles agent creation, execution, and turn message persistence. Manages the full turn lifecycle: creates a turn record before execution, tracks timing, extracts tool usage and child agent counts, and completes the turn with all metadata after execution. Includes autoSummarizeIfNeeded() for pre-turn budget checks with workflow context injection, and autoExtractMemories() which runs LLM-based memory extraction after each successful turn (configurable via agents.defaults.memory.autoExtract). Snapshots unread informational notifications into a transient prompt section and applies it to the live OrchestratorAgent for the current turn instead of injecting synthetic transcript messages. Also builds prompt-preview and prompt-budget snapshots used by the REPL and API inspection surfaces, including prompt-section rationale and pinning metadata. Queries ArtifactStore to build workflow context for summarization.

files.description: ReactPHP Fiber-based concurrent tool executor. Implements BatchToolExecutorInterface to enable parallel tool execution when multiple tool calls are returned by the LLM. Uses React\Async\parallel() to run each tool in its own Fiber — concurrency occurs during I/O suspension (HTTP requests, async network calls). Shell tools use blocking calls and do not benefit from Fiber concurrency. Single tool calls bypass Fiber overhead. TerminationException propagates correctly via parallel() rejection. Result ordering is preserved via ksort().

files.description: Core loop orchestration engine. Drives entire loop lifecycle (start, stage preparation, completion, iteration evaluation, advancement). Supports project resolution in startLoop via 3-tier fallback: explicit project_id/slug → active session project → auto-create. Headless start: when startLoop runs with no conversation session, auto-provisions a hidden loop-owned work-scope session (active project = loop's project) so LoopManager's project propagation and cross-stage artifact scoping apply unchanged, and records metadata.origin ('headless' | 'conversation'). Snapshots definitions, evaluates termination conditions (evaluation_bound, iteration_bound, goal_bound). Supports template parameters with {{placeholder}} substitution. Injects rich project context into stage prompts. Prepared stages carry typed LoopStageHandoffMetadata for persistence and observability. Constructor takes loopStore, projectStore, optional sessionStorage and goalEvaluator. Does not execute child agents directly — LoopManager handles execution via background tasks.

Publishes loop lifecycle notifications through NotificationPublisher, upgrading terminal loop failures to actionable notifications for the API-side automation runner while keeping stage/complete milestones informational.

files.description: Main Symfony Console command ('run'). Reached through the internal console binary used by the launcher-backed public `coqui` wrapper. Boots the entire system via BootManager, initializes the session, constructs all REPL handler objects and the SlashCommandRouter, then enters the REPL loop. Delegates slash commands to SlashCommandRouter and agent turns to AgentTurnExecutor. Also wires shared status readers like the shared GroupSessionService-backed /group command into REPL handlers. The readline path now performs throttled idle notification polling: transient informational notifications render as stacked blocks and unread badges, while open actionable notifications render as a sticky automation summary line without redrawing over active typing. The visible prompt context line now shows active group membership for group-enabled sessions while leaving the low-level readline marker neutral. Handles CLI flags --unsafe, --auto-approve, --update, --config, --new, --session, --workdir. Also supports headless mode (--no-terminal).

files.description: SQLite-backed session persistence. Tables: sessions, messages, child_runs, audit_log, turns, background_tasks, task_events, task_inputs, turn_processes, turn_events, session_title_jobs. WAL mode + foreign keys enabled. Supports creating/listing sessions, adding/loading messages, logging child runs, audit logging, token counts, turn lifecycle, interactive API turn-process tracking, queued session-title generation, profile-aware interactive session lookup, and session lifecycle state for active vs closed/archived conversations. Session rows now expose explicit visibility for hiding synthetic worker sessions, a canonical session_type discriminator alongside compatibility group fields, and aggregate lifecycle counts so archived history can be inspected without reactivating it. child_runs and background_tasks include structured metadata columns for typed coordination and provenance, including JSON metadata lookups used by notification automation for idempotent retry/escalation task creation. session_title_jobs is an internal queue for first-turn title generation that avoids blocking REPL/API response delivery while preserving replayable title events for turn inspection. Idempotent migrations add turn_id FK columns, title/profile columns, summarized-message flags, closed/archive lifecycle metadata, visibility, and the additive session_type column used by the new session-type architecture. Background-task persistence (records, events, inputs) is delegated to BackgroundTaskRecordStore; process-liveness checks use CoquiProcessChecker.

files.description: SQLite-backed artifact index. Table: artifacts (id, session_id, turn_id, title, type, content, language, filepath, stage, version counter, metadata, project_id, persistent, storage_mode, canonical_path, content_hash, timestamps; dormant sprint_id). Shares PDO connection from SessionStorage. For filesystem-backed types (plan/document/code/config) the canonical content lives on disk via ArtifactFileService and the DB content column is left empty (the file is the source of truth; history comes from the user's VCS); DB-only types (loop_output/data/other) store content inline. No per-version snapshot table — only a monotonic version counter on the row. A migration drops the legacy artifact_versions table. Supports CRUD, stage transitions (draft/review/final), and per-session listing with type/stage/project_id/created_after filters. cleanupFinalized() excludes loop_output and persistent artifacts (and removes their canonical files). create() auto-sets persistent=true when projectId is non-null, ensuring project-linked artifacts survive cleanup across background task process boundaries.

Stores memories in workspace/data/memory.db with area classification, tag-based organization, and per-entry importance scores. Hybrid search merges vector+FTS candidates, deduplicates by ID, and applies composite scoring (0.4*similarity + 0.2*recency + 0.25*importance + 0.15*access). Memories decay over time — inactive low-importance entries are archived (soft-deleted).
